items: DPIIT operationalised up to 100% FDI in insurance (incl. portfolio investors), automatic route, subject to IRDAI clearance
Aligns with **Sabka Bima Sabki Raksha Act, 2025** — effective 5 February 2026 (except Sec 25)
Insurers with FDI must retain ≥1 resident-Indian Chairperson/MD/CEO
Prior milestones: 100% FDI in intermediaries (2020); 20% FDI in LIC (2022)
